cat > /workspace/tmp/stress.py <<'PY'
import sys, ctypes, time, resource, json, random
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/submission','/workspace/vendor']
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
from netnomos.finite import compile_job, _minimal_covers
from itertools import product, combinations

# Every quadruple with one literal per group is minimal. All training
# sets are covered; the all-false unseen window supplies counterexamples.
# Larger than the initial learner's 250-rule cap.
fields=[dict(name='f'+str(i),type='count',domain=[0,1]) for i in range(4)]
j=dict(fields=fields, slots=1, predicates=[dict(kind='cmp',left={'ref':[0,'f'+str(i//8)]},op='eq',right={'const':1,'type':'count'}) for i in range(32)],width=4,
       train=[[[int(i==k) for i in range(4)]] for k in range(4)]*2500,
       approved=[list(c) for c in list(product(range(8),range(8,16),range(16,24),range(24,32)))[:256]],
       queries=[dict(fixed=[],target=[0,'f0'],prefix='') for _ in range(64)])
t=time.process_time();result=compile_job(j)
assert len(result['rules'])==4096
assert all(r['witnesses']==[0,1,2,3] and r['counterexample']==0 for r in result['rules'])
assert result['answers'][0]=={'count':15,'tokens':['0','1'],'witness':1}
print('4096-rule certificates / 10000 training rows:',time.process_time()-t,'CPU sec')

# A large declared domain plus 16 cells, most singleton.  Decode a large
# set of unseen values under a joint theory, not merely training rows.
n=65536
fields=[dict(name='f'+str(i),type='size',domain=list(range(n)) if i==0 else [1000000]) for i in range(8)]
# slots must be 1 because repeating the large domain would break universe bound.
j=dict(fields=fields,slots=1,predicates=[],width=4,train=[[[0]+[1000000]*7]]*10000,approved=[],queries=[])
for i in range(32):
    j['predicates'].append(dict(kind='cmp',left={'ref':[0,'f0']},op='le',right={'const':100+i,'type':'size'}))
j['approved']=[[i] for i in range(32)]
for i in range(64):
    j['queries'].append(dict(fixed=[{'ref':[0,'f'+str(k)],'value':1000000} for k in range(1,8)],target=[0,'f0'],prefix=str(i%20) if i%3 else ''))
t=time.process_time();result=compile_job(j)
assert len(result['rules'])==32
assert result['answers'][0]=={'count':101,'tokens':list('0123456789'),'witness':0}
print('65536-universe domain / 32 predicates / 10000 rows / 64 queries:',time.process_time()-t,'CPU sec')

# Stress all width-four candidate branches using adversarial arbitrary
# bitsets, beyond what low-dimensional predicate data usually generates.
rng=random.Random(49)
false=[rng.getrandbits(10000) for _ in range(32)]
t=time.process_time();covers=list(_minimal_covers(false,(1<<10000)-1,4))
assert covers==[]
print('41448 subsets on full 10000-bit evidence:',time.process_time()-t,'CPU sec')
print('Peak RSS (KiB):', resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
PY
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python3 -B /workspace/tmp/stress.py
